name: Vertiv Holdings Co

investment_theses.company_type: Critical Digital Infrastructure / Power Management for Data Centers

content: Vertiv Holdings Co is a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions. The company designs, manufactures, and services technologies that support data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial environments. Its comprehensive portfolio includes power management, thermal management, and IT management solutions, as well as services and software to optimize the performance and reliability of vital applications. Vertiv plays a crucial role in enabling the growth of cloud computing, edge computing, and the increasing demand for high-performance computing driven by artificial intelligence.

Officers

Giordano Albertazzi(Date: 2023 January)

Chief Executive Officer

Giordano Albertazzi is the Chief Executive Officer of Vertiv. He was appointed CEO in January 2023. Previously, he served as President, Americas from March 2022 to December 2022 and President, Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) from 2016 to 2022. He joined Emerson Network Power in 1998 and held various leadership positions.

David Fallon(Date: 2017 July)

Chief Financial Officer

David Fallon is the Chief Financial Officer of Vertiv, a position he has held since July 2017. Prior to joining Vertiv, he served as CFO at Noble International and held financial leadership roles at Textron Inc.

Stephen Liang(Date: 2021 February)

Chief Technology Officer

Stephen Liang is the Chief Technology Officer of Vertiv. He has been with the company and its predecessor, Emerson Network Power, since 1994. He was appointed CTO in February 2021 and previously served as President, Asia Pacific.

Directors

David M. Cote(Date: 2020 February)

Executive Chairman

David Cote is the Executive Chairman of the Board of Vertiv. He is the former Chairman and CEO of Honeywell. He also served as a Class B Director to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

Joseph van Dokkum(Date: 2020 February)

Director

Joseph van Dokkum is an Operating Partner at Kleiner Perkins. He previously served as President of UTC Power, a division of United Technologies Corporation.

Roger Fradin(Date: 2020 February)

Director

Roger Fradin served as Vice Chairman of Honeywell and has significant experience in industrial and technology sectors. He is also a director of L3Harris Technologies.

Jakki L. Haussler(Date: 2022 June)

Director

Jakki Haussler is the Chairman and co-founder of Opus Capital Management. She has extensive experience in financial services and investment management.
